audit.whatIsWrong: 'Repeating Dashes' is not an Ambessa ability. It appears as the tracked ability across the whole full layer, including focus.text. None of her real abilities are named anywhere.
audit.why: Her kit is Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E), Public Execution (R). Repudiation is a shield-and-brace that deals more damage if it blocked non-minion damage, so pouring damage into the brace is the trap. Drakehound's Step triggers off any cast, which is why chasing her dashes fails.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, enemyWin, focus.text, tradeGood, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] and the three dontsFull bodies now use the real names and the real behaviours.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Ornn Levels 2, 3 and the first-item window and called 4-5 and 6 even, while every content why for those rows describes Ambessa winning them, the packet chart gives her rows 2-6, and Ornn's win rate here is 48.32 percent.
audit.why: Lacerate (13s at rank 1) plus Drakehound's Step lets her weave out of the telegraphed Searing Charge, and Repudiation's brace punishes the trades Ornn can take before items.
audit.corrected: Rows 2 through 6 flipped to Ambessa in matched full/content pairs, ratings adjusted with them, and the full-layer whys rewritten to say why.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was boilerplate and hedged on 'Ambessa's ultimate'.
audit.why: Public Execution blinks to the farthest champion in a line, suppresses, then slams for a stun, on 130/115/100. Call of the Forge God is 140/120/100 and is Ornn's one pin, but she can bait the charge.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now gives Public Execution's 130s and states that 6 remains hers.

notes: 'Repeating Dashes' was a fabricated ability name used as the entire tracking hook for this matchup, including focus.text; replaced with Lacerate and Repudiation. The kit file flags Public Execution as a healing ability and the _missing file asks for anti-heal on that basis, but Riot's description for Public Execution states only the blink, suppression, slam and stun — no healing. Per the rule that the description beats a misfiring derived flag, no anti-heal advice was added and no healing is asserted; the existing report[8] anti-heal line was left untouched rather than removed. Left alone as unverified: whether Volcanic Rupture's grounding flag actually denies Drakehound's Step or Public Execution — Riot's Q text says damage, slow and pillar only.
